w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Ivy to Agnese, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 4,779 of 14,000 kcal."

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🤒 Chris is on the mend — the fever broke.

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. Stonebridge isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Network Note is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Daniel opens the pantry wide: 3× Aid from Thornfield, 1× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Chris eat until the fire burns low.
